name: Nekoyashiki Maher
source:
Affiliation: Luminous Academy, class 2-C
Class: Sword Princess
Hobbies: Games, eating street food
Likes: Shooting games, shopping
Dislikes: Quiz games, studying

The number 1 gamer within the academy who is almost considered as the idol of the gaming world. She is equally popular with both girls and boys due to her outgoing and honest personality. She is also a childhood friend and neighbor of [url=/c42032]Koharu[/url].
